title: The Field: On Election Day, 'Two Different Worlds'

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于 nytimes.com 免费直播部分精选访谈，供任何人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Reid, where are we, and why are we here?
sentences.zh: 里德，我们在哪儿，我们为什么在这里？

sentences.en: We are just outside of Rhinelander, Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 我们就在威斯康星州莱茵兰德的郊外。

sentences.en: There's snow on the ground everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是积雪。

sentences.en: The car says it is 29 degrees.
sentences.zh: 车上显示温度是零下两度。

sentences.en: It's days before the election.
sentences.zh: 距离大选只有几天了。

sentences.en: You know, this is a fairly Republican area.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个相当支持共和党的地区。

sentences.en: It's in the north woods of Wisconsin, near the Michigan border.
sentences.zh: 它位于威斯康星州北部森林，靠近密歇根州边境。

sentences.en: And yet there are Democrats that are putting up a big fight to try to get out their voters that just didn't exist four years ago and, frankly, in a lot of years before that.
sentences.zh: 然而，有些民主党人正在全力以赴地争取调动他们的选民，这在四年前是根本不存在的，坦白说，在过去的很多年里也是如此。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, this is The Field.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这是《实地报道》。

sentences.en: I'm Reid Epstein in Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 我是里德·爱泼斯坦，在威斯康星州为您报道。

sentences.en: In 2016, Wisconsin was the forgotten state.
sentences.zh: 2016年，威斯康星州是被遗忘的州。

sentences.en: After it had reliably voted for every Democratic presidential candidate since 1988,
sentences.zh: 在它自1988年以来一直可靠地投票给每一位民主党总统候选人之后，

sentences.en: Hillary Clinton never once traveled there during the campaign.
sentences.zh: 希拉里·克林顿在竞选期间一次也没有去过那里。

sentences.en: And on election night 2016, four years ago, Donald Trump shocked pollsters when he won the state by less than 1%,
sentences.zh: 而在2016年选举之夜的四年前，唐纳德·特朗普以不到1%的优势赢得该州，震惊了民调专家，

sentences.en: cementing his path to victory through the white working-class voters of the upper MidweSt.
sentences.zh: 巩固了他通过美国中西部上游地区白人蓝领选民走向胜利的道路。

sentences.en: So last week, I traveled with my colleagues, Andy Mills and Luke Vanderplugge, to the north woods of Wisconsin,
sentences.zh: 所以上周，我和我的同事安迪·米尔斯和卢克·范德普鲁格一起去了威斯康星州北部森林，

sentences.en: the most forgotten part, in the most forgotten state, to look at one particular race happening there,
sentences.zh: 这个被遗忘的州中最被遗忘的部分，去观察那里正在进行的一场特定竞选，

sentences.en: a race that has pitted neighbor against neighbor, against the backdrop of a surging pandemic,
sentences.zh: 这场竞选在疫情激增的背景下，让邻居与邻居针锋相对，

sentences.en: a race that in many ways is a microcosm of where America finds itself today, on election day.
sentences.zh: 这场竞选在许多方面正是选举日今天美国现状的一个缩影。

sentences.en: I'm sorry about that, guys.
sentences.zh: 真抱歉，伙计们。

sentences.en: This place looks great.
sentences.zh: 这地方看起来真不错。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢。

sentences.en: This is the real thing.
sentences.zh: 这可是货真价实的。

sentences.en: This was built right after Prohibition, 1932, 1933.
sentences.zh: 这是禁酒令刚结束时建的，1932年、1933年。

sentences.en: Our first stop was at the Algen Dinner Club in Rhinelander.
sentences.zh: 我们的第一站是莱茵兰德的阿尔根晚餐俱乐部。

sentences.en: It's called the Algen because the original owners were Al and Genevieve Nelson.
sentences.zh: 之所以叫阿尔根，是因为最初的老板叫阿尔和吉纳维芙·纳尔逊。

sentences.en: And nobody ever changed their name.
sentences.zh: 而且从来没有人改过名字。

sentences.en: How many taxidermied animals do you think you've got in here?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这里有多少个动物标本？

sentences.en: I see you've got deer, you've got black bear, you've got fish hanging.
sentences.zh: 我看到你有鹿，有黑熊，还有挂着的鱼。

sentences.en: It's an old, charming log cabin with lots of dead animals looking down at you from the walls.
sentences.zh: 这是一间古老迷人的原木小屋，墙上有许多死去的动物正看着你。

sentences.en: That's pretty much standard stuff in the north woods, you know?
sentences.zh: 在北部森林这基本上是标准配置，你知道吗？

sentences.en: We were there to talk to the owner, a quintessential up north guy, friendly, inviting, broad-shouldered, with a picturesque Tom Selleck mustache.
sentences.zh: 我们在那儿是为了采访老板，一个典型的北方人，友好、热情、宽肩膀，留着标志性的汤姆·塞立克式小胡子。

sentences.en: So my name is Rob Swearengin.
sentences.zh: 所以我的名字是罗布·斯威伦金。

sentences.en: I am currently the state representative for the 34th Assembly District in the Wisconsin State Assembly.
sentences.zh: 我目前是威斯康星州众议院第34议会区的州众议员。

sentences.en: And a four-term state assemblyman in Wisconsin, running for re-election and on the ballot today.
sentences.zh: 同时也是威斯康星州的四任州众议员，正在竞选连任，今天就在选票上。

sentences.en: This is the fifth time that you've run for this scene?
sentences.zh: 这是你第五次竞选这个职位吗？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And his race has come to embody the very divisions that are separating so much of the country right now.
sentences.zh: 而他的竞选已经体现了目前正在撕裂美国大部分地区的种种分歧。

sentences.en: I think we want to start sort of who you are and how we got here.
sentences.zh: 我想我们先从你是谁以及你是如何走到这一步开始聊起。

sentences.en: So I'm a lifelong resident of Rhinelander.
sentences.zh: 我是莱茵兰德的永久居民。

sentences.en: So I was born here, raised here, went to Rhinelander High School, graduated in 1981.
sentences.zh: 我在这里出生，在这里长大，上过莱茵兰德高中，1981年毕业。

sentences.en: My mom was a waitress downtown for one of the mainstay places for years, for 30-some years she was a waitress down there.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈曾在市中心的一家主力餐厅当服务员多年，她在那里当了三十多年服务员。

sentences.en: I started out as a busboy at the resort just about two miles down the road.
sentences.zh: 我刚开始是在离这儿大约两英里远的那家度假村当清理桌子的杂工。

sentences.en: Eventually ended up being a bartender there.
sentences.zh: 最后在那儿成了一名调酒师。

sentences.en: So that was kind of like my entrance into hospitality.
sentences.zh: 所以那可以说是我的酒店业入门。

sentences.en: Rob says that eventually, as he got older and got married to his high school sweetheart...
sentences.zh: 罗布说，随着他年龄渐长并与高中时的恋人结婚……

sentences.en: I attended a bar for a few people.
sentences.zh: 我为几个人经营了一家酒吧。

sentences.en: I decided to take the plunge myself.
sentences.zh: 我决定自己也去闯一闯。

sentences.en: He started looking to become a restaurant owner himself.
sentences.zh: 他开始考虑自己成为一名餐馆老板。

sentences.en: And one night, he was eating here at the Algen, a place where he'd been a regular since he was a small kid.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，他正在阿尔根餐厅吃饭，这个地方他从小就是常客。

sentences.en: Came down here quite a bit for dinner and the folks that owned this place were very dear friends of ours, no relation.
sentences.zh: 经常来这里吃晚饭，拥有这个地方的人是我们非常亲爱的朋友，没有亲戚关系。

sentences.en: They approached my wife and I both and said, you really should consider taking over for us.
sentences.zh: 他们走过来对我和我妻子说，你们真的应该考虑接替我们。

sentences.en: We wanted to retire.
sentences.zh: 我们想退休了。

sentences.en: And that was 28 years ago.
sentences.zh: 那是28年前的事了。

sentences.en: And Rob, he tells this story.
sentences.zh: 罗布讲了这个故事。

sentences.en: The locals...
sentences.zh: 当地人……

sentences.en: As a sort of allegory to his community.
sentences.zh: 作为对他所在的社区的一种某种寓言。

sentences.en: In the Northwoods, especially in the Rhinelander area, take good care of their local businesses and especially, you know, restaurants and supper clubs.
sentences.zh: 在北部森林，特别是在莱茵兰德地区，人们非常照顾当地的企业，尤其是餐馆和晚餐俱乐部。

sentences.en: So while our business is largely tourist-related in the summertime, in the wintertime and for the rest of the year, for that matter,
sentences.zh: 所以虽然我们的业务在夏天主要与游客有关，但在冬天以及一年中的其余时间里，

sentences.en: it's largely from the locals that keep us going.
sentences.zh: 很大程度上靠的是让我们维持下去的当地人。

sentences.en: And since my wife and I are both locals all of our lives, we know a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 既然我和我妻子一生都是当地人，我们认识很多人。

sentences.en: It's a community, you get the impression...
sentences.zh: 这是一个社区，你会有一种印象……

sentences.en: Living the life, I guess.
sentences.zh: 过着这种生活，我想。

sentences.en: ...that he really loves.
sentences.zh: ……他真的很热爱这一切。

sentences.en: And he describes his politics as just kind of flowing naturally out of that.
sentences.zh: 他把自己的政治观描述为自然而然地从这种生活中流露出来的。

sentences.en: Once you get involved in, you know, this is your lifeblood.
sentences.zh: 一旦你参与进来，你知道的，这就是你的命脉。

sentences.en: So you got to worry about making a living.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须担心谋生问题。

sentences.en: And so what happens in Madison or in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 因此在麦迪逊或华盛顿特区发生的事情

sentences.en: are directly linked to how this business operates.
sentences.zh: 与这家店的运营方式直接相关。

sentences.en: So, for example...
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子……

sentences.en: You know, the smoking ban was a big one.
sentences.zh: 你知道，禁烟令是一个大事件。

sentences.en: He fought against Wisconsin's statewide smoking ban.
sentences.zh: 他反对威斯康星州的全州禁烟令。

sentences.en: You were a fan of it or you were against it?
sentences.zh: 你是支持它还是反对它？

sentences.en: No, we were against it.
sentences.zh: 不，我们反对。

sentences.en: Yeah, we were against it because we were small businesses being told what to do by the government.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们反对是因为我们是小企业，却被政府告知该做什么。

sentences.en: You know, so it was a frustrating thing.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一件令人沮丧的事情。

sentences.en: You wanted to continue to be able to smoke indoors.
sentences.zh: 你希望能够继续在室内吸烟。

sentences.en: Correct, yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错，是的。

sentences.en: Right, leave it up to us.
sentences.zh: 对，由我们自己决定。

sentences.en: It was our decision to make.
sentences.zh: 这是我们必须做出的决定。

sentences.en: A customer can, you know, smart enough to figure out whether or not they want to go to a place that allows smoking or not.
sentences.zh: 顾客可以，你知道的，足够聪明去弄清楚他们是否想去一个允许吸烟的地方。

sentences.en: He fought against changing Wisconsin's drinking age requirements.
sentences.zh: 他反对改变威斯康星州的饮酒年龄要求。

sentences.en: Raising the drinking age from 18 to 21.
sentences.zh: 将法定饮酒年龄从18岁提高到21岁。

sentences.en: But Rob says nothing in his political experience prepared him for what happened this spring, starting on March 17th.
sentences.zh: 但罗布说，他政治生涯中的任何经历都没有让他为今年春天从3月17日开始发生的事情做好准备。

sentences.en: St. Patrick's Day.
sentences.zh: 圣帕特里克节。

sentences.en: What does St. Patrick's Day mean to you?
sentences.zh: 圣帕特里克节对你意味着什么？

sentences.en: It's a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这是一件大事。

sentences.en: You know, the corned beef and cabbage was cooking and ready to go.
sentences.zh: 你知道，咸牛肉和卷心菜正在煮着，准备好了。

sentences.en: Yeah, people drinking green beer.
sentences.zh: 是的，人们在喝绿色的啤酒。

sentences.en: And the governor said, no, you're all closed at 5 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 州长却说，不行，你们所有人必须在5点钟关门。

sentences.en: When the coronavirus first hit in the spring, the state of Wisconsin, like the rest of the country, went into a sudden lockdown.
sentences.zh: 当今年春天冠状病毒刚爆发时，威斯康星州和全国其他地方一样，突然进入了封锁状态。

sentences.en: The governor of the state shut down every bar and restaurant within four hours on St. Patrick's Day.
sentences.zh: 州长在圣帕特里克节当天在四个小时内关闭了所有的酒吧和餐馆。

sentences.en: We tried surviving carryouts.
sentences.zh: 我们试图靠外卖生存。

sentences.en: Well, that quickly deteriorated on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday because it just wasn't paying.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这在周二、周三和周四很快就恶化了，因为根本不赚钱。

sentences.en: So the restaurant was closed for the first time ever during the week.
sentences.zh: 所以这家餐厅有史以来第一次在工作日关闭了。

sentences.en: So we were only open three nights a week, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
sentences.zh: 所以我们一周只营业三个晚上，周五、周六和周日。

sentences.en: I still feel a responsibility to my employees, right?
sentences.zh: 我仍然对我的员工负有责任，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, they work here.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们在这里工作。

sentences.en: I want them to make a living to be able to provide for their families.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们能谋生并养家糊口。

sentences.en: So it was pretty scary stuff there for a while.
sentences.zh: 所以在一段时间里，这挺吓人的。

sentences.en: Eventually, the restrictions that Governor Tony Evers, a Democrat, ordered from Madison, were challenged by Rob and his Republican colleagues in the state legislature.
sentences.zh: 最终，民主党州长托尼·埃弗斯从麦迪逊下令的限制措施，遭到罗布和他在州议会的共和党同僚的挑战。

sentences.en: They were thrown out by the courts.
sentences.zh: 它们被法院驳回了。

sentences.en: And Rob's restaurant, like others, was allowed to reopen, though strongly encouraged to implement social distancing measures to keep employees and guests safe.
sentences.zh: 罗布的餐厅和其他餐厅一样被允许重新开业，尽管被强烈鼓励实施社交距离措施以保证员工和客人的安全。

sentences.en: And we tried, you know, seating every other table and trying the social distancing.
sentences.zh: 我们尝试过，你知道的，每隔一张桌子安排座位并尝试保持社交距离。

sentences.en: But there was, you know, there was some reality to the fact that when people come into a cocktail lounge, they're here to have a little fun.
sentences.zh: 但有一个现实情况是，当人们来到鸡尾酒吧时，他们是来找点乐子的。

sentences.en: Rob said he and his staff started off separating the tables, but that it just didn't work.
sentences.zh: 罗布说他和他的员工一开始把桌子隔开，但这根本行不通。

sentences.en: There was a perception that I saw people that had COVID up to here.
sentences.zh: 有一种看法是，我看到人们对新冠的恐惧已经到头了。

sentences.en: We're done with COVID.
sentences.zh: 我们受够新冠了。

sentences.en: We want to go on and live our lives, whether it was coming out to dinner or going to a tavern or whatever the case may be.
sentences.zh: 我们想要继续过我们的生活，无论是出来吃晚饭还是去酒馆，还是其他什么情况。

sentences.en: And to Rob, that made some sense.
sentences.zh: 对罗布来说，这有点道理。

sentences.en: Because what works in Milwaukee didn't need to be applied to us up here.
sentences.zh: 因为在密尔沃基行之有效的东西，没必要强加给我们这里的人。

sentences.en: It's like masks.
sentences.zh: 就像戴口罩一样。

sentences.en: Out of respect, if the sign on the door says you've got to wear a mask to go into Walmart or Menards or the local sporting goods store or Home Depot, you've got to wear a mask.
sentences.zh: 出于尊重，如果门上的标志说你必须戴口罩才能进入沃尔玛、梅纳德斯、当地的体育用品商店或家得宝，你就得戴口罩。

sentences.en: That's the deal.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: But I don't think that we needed a mandate from the governor saying you have to wear a mask.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们不需要州长的强制令来规定你必须戴口罩。

sentences.en: Everybody was pretty much doing it common sense-wise anyway.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，大家凭常识基本上都在这么做。

sentences.en: What are people in here doing as far as masks?
sentences.zh: 这里的人在戴口罩方面是怎么做的？

sentences.en: People will come in wearing a mask, but they don't wear it long.
sentences.zh: 人们会戴着口罩进来，但他们不会戴很久。

sentences.en: I mean, first of all, we're an eating and drinking establishment.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，首先，我们是一个餐饮场所。

sentences.en: It's hard to do that with a mask on.
sentences.zh: 戴着口罩很难做到这一点。

sentences.en: Most of the waitresses are wearing a mask.
sentences.zh: 大多数女服务员都戴着口罩。

sentences.en: A couple can't because of some respiratory issues.
sentences.zh: 有几个因为呼吸道问题不能戴。

sentences.en: And so for the most part, you know, we still have that common sense and that respect when people come in.
sentences.zh: 所以在很大程度上，你知道的，当人们进来时，我们仍然保持着那种常识和尊重。

sentences.en: Rob wasn't wearing a mask when we got to his restaurant or during our interview, though he did offer to put one on if it made us feel uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 当我们到达他的餐厅时，或者在我们的采访过程中，罗布没有戴口罩，尽管如果这让我们感到不舒服，他确实提出要戴上一个。

sentences.en: And he said this kind of loose interpretation of the governor's mandate, it's not just him.
sentences.zh: 他说这种对州长命令的宽松解读，不只是他一个人这样。

sentences.en: That's the approach that a lot of businesses in the Northwoods are taking.
sentences.zh: 这是北部森林许多企业正在采取的方法。

sentences.en: This governor, for whatever reason, people are kind of ignoring his edicts.
sentences.zh: 不管出于什么原因，这个州长，人们有点在忽视他的法令。

sentences.en: These state edicts, they rely on locals to enforce them.
sentences.zh: 这些州级法令，它们依靠当地人来执行。

sentences.en: But Rob told us the Oneida County Sheriff and the local health departments, they're not interested in doing that.
sentences.zh: 但罗布告诉我们，奥奈达县治安官和当地卫生部门对做这件事不感兴趣。

sentences.en: Local law enforcement came out and said, that's not our job.
sentences.zh: 当地执法部门出来说，这不是我们的工作。

sentences.en: So don't be calling the police department or the sheriff's department because somebody came in here not wearing a mask.
sentences.zh: 所以不要因为有人没戴口罩进来就打电话给警察局或治安官办公室。

sentences.en: But in recent weeks, the coronavirus has surged in Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 但在最近几周，威斯康星州的冠状病毒病例激增。

sentences.en: And the state is now in the midst of one of the country's worst outbreaks.
sentences.zh: 该州目前正处于全国最严重的疫情爆发之一之中。

sentences.en: And it's come to the Northwoods.
sentences.zh: 而且它已经蔓延到了北部森林。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons I wanted to talk to Rob is because of something I'd heard that happened here a few weeks back and that had turned political in town.
sentences.zh: 我想和罗布谈谈的原因之一，是因为我听说几周前这里发生了一件事，并在镇上变得政治化了。

sentences.en: One of his employees had gotten the virus and gotten it bad.
sentences.zh: 他的一个员工感染了病毒，而且病情严重。

sentences.en: Pam Haskins, who was one of your waitresses, who I guess got sick.
sentences.zh: 帕姆·哈斯金斯，你的一个女服务员，我听说她生病了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Can you tell us what happened with her?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们她身上发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: So all my waitresses are part-time and she also works in health care.
sentences.zh: 我的所有女服务员都是兼职，她还在医疗保健行业工作。

sentences.en: And she contracted COVID.
sentences.zh: 她感染了新冠。

sentences.en: And she was one of the ones that was, I mean, it's just an awful story.
sentences.zh: 而且她也是其中一个……我的意思是，这真的是个可怕的故事。

sentences.en: She ended up in the ICU, you know.
sentences.zh: 她最后进了重症监护室，你知道的。

sentences.en: And first of all, she's fine.
sentences.zh: 首先，她现在没事了。

sentences.en: She's back home and she's been texting with my wife and she's just a great gal.
sentences.zh: 她已经回家了，一直在和我妻子发短信，她真的是个很棒的姑娘。

sentences.en: But unfortunately, her husband visited her in the hospital and got sick as well.
sentences.zh: 但不幸的是，她丈夫去医院看望她，结果也生病了。

sentences.en: And the story escalates to where he left her bedside one day and he was in the hospital as well in a different room.
sentences.zh: 事情越闹越大，有一天他离开了她的病床，结果自己也住进了医院的另一间病房。

sentences.en: And a blood clot let loose and he was flight-related to Marshfield and later died.
sentences.zh: 然后一个血栓脱落了，他被紧急空运到马什菲尔德，随后不幸去世。

sentences.en: So it's just an awful story.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的是个可怕的故事。

sentences.en: Awful story.
sentences.zh: 可怕的故事。

sentences.en: But, yeah, we haven't seen Pam now in probably a month and a half or so.
sentences.zh: 不过，对，我们大概有一个半月没见到帕姆了。

sentences.en: But she's back home recovering.
sentences.zh: 但她已经回家休养了。

sentences.en: And did anybody else who worked here got sick?
sentences.zh: 这里还有其他人工作时生病了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I had one bartender that she was out for a couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 对，我有一个女酒保请了两周假。

sentences.en: She's doing fine.
sentences.zh: 她现在挺好的。

sentences.en: My second bartender, his wife got it.
sentences.zh: 我的第二个酒保，他妻子感染了。

sentences.en: And then so he ultimately got it.
sentences.zh: 然后他最终也感染了。

sentences.en: So he quarantined for actually a month because he's an older guy.
sentences.zh: 所以他实际上隔离了一个月，因为他年纪比较大。
他70岁，77岁了。

sentences.en: And so he just came back after being off for five weeks.
sentences.zh: 所以他休息了五个星期后刚回来。

sentences.en: Did you have other people who worked here get tested after sort of people who had been in the restaurant got sick?
sentences.zh: 在一些去过餐厅的人生病之后，你们这里还有其他人去接受检测吗？

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 没有，没有。

sentences.en: We've never been contacted by a local health department.
sentences.zh: 我们从来没接到过当地卫生部门的联系。

sentences.en: My wife and I never had it.
sentences.zh: 我和我妻子从来没得过。

sentences.en: Have you gone in to get tested?
sentences.zh: 你有没有去做过检测？

sentences.en: No, I haven't.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有。

sentences.en: I haven't.
sentences.zh: 我没有。

sentences.en: Neither has my wife.
sentences.zh: 我妻子也没有。

sentences.en: What do you say to people who say, okay, you laxed some of the guidelines coming down from the governor's office and some of your workers got sick?
sentences.zh: 你对那些人怎么说？他们说，好吧，你们放松了州长办公室下达的一些防疫指南，导致你们的一些员工生病了？

sentences.en: One of your workers likely gave that sickness to her husband.
sentences.zh: 你们的一个员工很可能把病毒传染给了她的丈夫。

sentences.en: Her husband died.
sentences.zh: 她丈夫去世了。

sentences.en: And they say, like, how in the face of that do you think that this one-size-fits-all thing is too strict and that the money that you want to make off your business is worth it?
sentences.zh: 他们说，鉴于这种情况，你怎么还认为这种一刀切的政策太严格了，怎么会觉得你想从生意中赚取的利润是值得的？

sentences.en: Like, what do you say to someone who says that?
sentences.zh: 比如说，你对这样说的人有什么回应？

sentences.en: Well, you know, first of all, like I say, there's been no connection to the restaurant to all these, you know,
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，首先，就像我说的，这跟餐厅没有任何联系，所有这些，你知道的，

sentences.en: because all these people are part-time coming from different jobs and different things.
sentences.zh: 因为这些人都是兼职，来自不同的工作和不同的地方。

sentences.en: Rob rejects the possibility that Pam got the virus from his supper club.
sentences.zh: 罗布否认帕姆是从他的俱乐部感染病毒的可能性。

sentences.en: And I, you know, trust me, Scott that died, he's a good guy.
sentences.zh: 而且我，你知道的，相信我，去世的斯科特是个好人。

sentences.en: He's a good guy.
sentences.zh: 他是个好人。

sentences.en: And Pam is a wonderful lady, too.
sentences.zh: 帕姆也是个非常好的人。

sentences.en: But, yeah, moving forward, I mean, we take the same precautions we have since the beginning of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 但是，对，展望未来，我的意思是，我们采取的防范措施和自大流行开始以来一模一样。

sentences.en: And he defends the restaurant's safety protocols.
sentences.zh: 并且他为餐厅的安全协议进行了辩护。

sentences.en: But this is exactly the sort of behavior that Rob's Democratic challenger has seized on and made a focal point of his campaign and tried to mobilize local Democrats around.
sentences.zh: 但正是这种行为，成了罗布的民主党竞争对手紧抓不放的把柄，成为了他竞选的核心，并试图以此动员当地的民主党人。

sentences.en: How do you speak to that kind of criticism?
sentences.zh: 你如何看待这种批评？

sentences.en: Well, I would argue that what we're doing is working, you know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我会说我们正在做的事是有效的，你知道的。

sentences.en: And people call and say, look, this may not be the place for you if, you know, if I have a waitress that has a respiratory problem that she can't wear a mask.
sentences.zh: 有人打电话来说，看，如果，你知道的，如果我的一个女服务员有呼吸系统问题无法佩戴口罩，这可能就不适合你。

sentences.en: Or we had a reservation a week ago that insisted that the waitress wear a mask.
sentences.zh: 或者我们一周前有个预约，对方坚持要求女服务员戴口罩。

sentences.en: I said, absolutely, we can do that for you.
sentences.zh: 我说，没问题，我们可以为你做到这一点。

sentences.en: So you just, you know, you can do a lot of that sometimes on a case-by-case.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，有时候你可以根据具体情况处理很多这样的事情。

sentences.en: But for the most part, we're trying to keep some level of stability for the restaurant, for the employees that work here.
sentences.zh: 但对大多数情况来说，我们只是试图为餐厅、为在这里工作的员工维持某种程度的稳定性。

sentences.en: Herein lies the political divide between people who think keeping businesses running is the ultimate priority and those who think keeping people healthy is the ultimate priority.
sentences.zh: 这就体现了政治分歧：一方认为维持企业运转是最高优先级，另一方则认为保障人们健康是最高优先级。

sentences.en: Like Rob's opponent, who just so happens to also own a local restaurant.
sentences.zh: 就像罗布的对手那样，而他刚好也拥有一家当地餐厅。

sentences.en: Who is your political opponent?
sentences.zh: 你的政治对手是谁？

sentences.en: And what do you make of him?
sentences.zh: 你觉得他怎么样？

sentences.en: He apparently grew up in Stevens Point, right?
sentences.zh: 他显然是在史蒂文斯波伊特长大的，对吧？

sentences.en: This is a college town about an hour and a half south of Rhinelander.
sentences.zh: 这是一个大学城，在莱茵兰德以南大约一个半小时的车程。

sentences.en: And went off to Harvard University, Harvard College, through Massachusetts and New York.
sentences.zh: 后来去了哈佛大学、哈佛学院，经由马萨诸塞州和纽约。

sentences.en: Along the way, he turned out to be an opera singer.
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中，他成了一名歌剧演员。

sentences.en: And it would seem to me that he's kind of an elitiSt.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，他有点像个精英主义者。

sentences.en: And I don't think he's a very good fit for somebody who wants to represent the Northwoods in Madison.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他很不适合代表北森林区去麦迪逊。

sentences.en: Do you have any sense of how he's handled his restaurant during the pandemic?
sentences.zh: 你知道他在大流行期间是怎么经营他的餐厅的吗？

sentences.en: Well, he aligned himself very closely with Governor Evers' decisions, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，他与埃弗斯州长的决定保持了高度一致，对吧？

sentences.en: So he took everything to the 10th power, shut the building down, served outside, you know, had a tent in the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 所以他把一切都做到了极致，关掉了大楼，提供户外服务，你知道的，在停车场搭了个帐篷。

sentences.en: And now, of course, he's closed it up, citing COVID.
sentences.zh: 而现在，当然，他以新冠为由把店关了。

sentences.en: So he claims he's going to be opening again next spring.
sentences.zh: 所以他声称明年春天会重新开业。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: We've been targeted by my opponent as, you know, the den of COVID and all sorts of rumors and Facebook.
sentences.zh: 我们被我的对手当作，你知道的，新冠病毒的发源地，并在脸书上散布各种谣言。

sentences.en: I've never quite had to fight against Facebook in an election.
sentences.zh: 我还从没在选举中跟脸书对过垒呢。

sentences.en: What's he saying?
sentences.zh: 他在说什么？

sentences.en: Well, he created a list of places that don't enforce the mask mandate and felt the need to put all those places on his Facebook page.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他列出了一份不执行口罩令的场所名单，并且觉得有必要把所有这些地方都发到他的脸书主页上。

sentences.en: This is true.
sentences.zh: 这是真的。

sentences.en: You're on that liSt.
sentences.zh: 你在那个名单上。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, for sure.
sentences.zh: 哦，对，肯定的。

sentences.en: Yeah, for sure.
sentences.zh: 对，肯定的。

sentences.en: And not only did Rob's opponent put him on a list, but he actually shared a Photoshopped picture of Rob wearing a shirt that originally said,
sentences.zh: 不仅罗布的对手把他列入了名单，他还分享了一张PS过的罗布的照片，照片上的衬衫原本写着，

sentences.en: I heart libraries, but he changed it to I heart COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 我爱图书馆，但他给改成了我爱新冠肺炎。

sentences.en: There's some nasty stuff out there.
sentences.zh: 外面有些很恶劣的东西。

sentences.en: You get people that are kind of stalking me, trying to catch me not wearing a mask at Walmart.
sentences.zh: 你会遇到一些人，有点像在跟踪我，试图抓拍我在沃尔玛没戴口罩的样子。

sentences.en: You know, it's just like stuff that you've never, never thought I'd have to deal with.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这就像是你从未、从未想过自己会需要应对的事情。

sentences.en: And then Rob said just what I'd been thinking.
sentences.zh: 然后罗布说出了我一直在想的话。

sentences.en: I think it's interesting that we're both in business and yet have these total opposite views, right?
sentences.zh: 我觉得很有意思，我们俩都在经商，却有着完全相反的观点，对吧？

sentences.en: As political opponents, as restaurant owners, these guys are operating in complete contraSt.
sentences.zh: 作为政治对手，作为餐厅老板，这两个家伙的作风完全相反。

sentences.en: I mean, in previous races, I could point to my opponent and say, this guy has never run a business.
sentences.zh: 我是说，在先前的竞选中，我可以指着我的对手说，这家伙从来没经营过企业。

sentences.en: He doesn't know what it's like to sign a paycheck, to make a payroll.
sentences.zh: 他不知道签发薪水、发放工资是什么滋味。

sentences.en: I can't say that with my opponent this time around, but it is really unusual for a small town businessman to be so entrenched in those democratic beliefs, from my perspective,
sentences.zh: 这次面对对手我不能这么说，但从我的角度来看，一个小镇商人如此根深蒂固地信奉民主党的信念，

sentences.en: to ruin your own business.
sentences.zh: 以至于毁了自己的生意，这真的很不寻常。

sentences.en: Because I think that's what he's done.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得这就是他所做的事。

sentences.en: I mean, he shut his business down.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他把自己的生意给关了。

sentences.en: I mean, that's a pretty strong belief.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这是一种相当坚定的信念。

sentences.en: What's going on?
sentences.zh: 怎么回事？

sentences.en: Hi there, I'm Andy.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安迪。

sentences.en: Cold enough for you fuckers today, huh?
sentences.zh: 你们这群混蛋今天觉得够冷了吗，哈？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Jesus ChriSt.
sentences.zh: 基督耶稣。

sentences.en: So after talking to Rob,
sentences.zh: 所以在跟罗布谈过之后，

sentences.en: Fuck, it's nuts.
sentences.zh: 操，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: I mean, it's Wisconsin, but it's not this bad.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这里是威斯康星州，但也没这么冷吧。

sentences.en: We drove about 30 minutes north to the town of Manacqua to meet his opponent, Kirk Bankstead.
sentences.zh: 我们向北驱车大约30分钟来到了曼夸卡镇，去见他的对手柯克·班克斯泰德。

sentences.en: Do you want to do something outside before we go inside?
sentences.zh: 我们在进去之前想先在外面做点什么吗？

sentences.en: He met us outside his bar, the Manacqua Brewing Company.
sentences.zh: 他在他的酒吧——曼夸卡酿酒公司外面迎候我们。

sentences.en: And there's this gigantic blue Biden-Harris sign hanging across one side of the building.
sentences.zh: 建筑物的一侧悬挂着一块巨大的蓝色拜登-哈里斯标牌。

sentences.en: This is the, downstairs is more of the pub.
sentences.zh: 这里是，楼下更像是个酒吧。

sentences.en: Up here is more of the, like, the music menu.
sentences.zh: 这上面更像是，类似于音乐餐单。

sentences.en: This is very nice.
sentences.zh: 这里非常漂亮。

sentences.en: It's about as different from the Algen as you can imagine.
sentences.zh: 这跟你能想象到的阿尔根酒吧完全不同。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's like a stage with big sort of floor-to-ceiling windows that overlook the lake.
sentences.zh: 对，就像是一个带有巨大落地窗的舞台，可以俯瞰湖景。

sentences.en: We settle in for the interview.
sentences.zh: 我们坐下来开始采访。

sentences.en: This time, everyone's wearing a mask.
sentences.zh: 这一次，每个人都戴着口罩。

sentences.en: Um, okay, so did you, did you want to start, where do you want, do you want to start with the questions?
sentences.zh: 呃，好的，那么你，你想开始了吗，你想把，你想从哪些问题开始？

sentences.en: Or, I think everybody wanted to hear you sing.
sentences.zh: 或者说，我想大家都想听你唱歌。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, we just, we figured it's going to happen eventually.
sentences.zh: 对，我是说，我们只是觉得这总会发生的。

sentences.en: I mean, the train!
sentences.zh: 我是说，这列火车！

sentences.en: Now ask me how far they got me in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 现在问问我在曼哈顿混到了什么地步。

sentences.en: Kirk is indeed a classically trained opera singer, and it doesn't take much prompting to get him going.
sentences.zh: 柯克确实是一位受过古典训练的歌剧演员，而且不需要太多提示就能让他唱起来。

sentences.en: How far does it get you in Wisconsin, though?
sentences.zh: 不过，这在威斯康星州能让你混到什么地步呢？

sentences.en: It gets me on that stage right there, but I own it, so it's kind of easy to book myself.
sentences.zh: 它让我登上了眼前的这个舞台，不过我是这儿的老板，所以给自己预约演出还挺容易的。

sentences.en: Do you still get a lot of opportunities to sing now that you're back here?
sentences.zh: 你现在回到这里后，还有很多唱歌的机会吗？

sentences.en: Um, well, before I close the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 嗯，好吧，在我关掉餐厅之前。

sentences.en: I mean, that's kind of one of the reasons I bought this place.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这也是我买下这个地方的原因之一。

sentences.en: Like Rob said, Kirk is handling his business very differently during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 正如罗布所说，柯克在大流行期间处理自己生意的方式截然不同。

sentences.en: When the virus hit, he filed for a federal PPP loan and moved to takeout only.
sentences.zh: 当病毒袭来时，他申请了联邦薪资保护计划（PPP）贷款，并转为只提供外卖。

sentences.en: He put up a tent and opened for a business outside during the summer, but shut down again when the tourist crowd left after Labor Day.
sentences.zh: 他在夏天搭起帐篷开展户外营业，但在劳动节过后游客散去时再次关门。

sentences.en: Which gave him the time to do something else, like run against Rob, who actually had a lot of the basic facts of Kirk's story right.
sentences.zh: 这让他有了时间去做别的事情，比如竞选对阵罗布，而罗布其实把柯克经历中的很多基本事实都弄对了。

sentences.en: I grew up in Stevens Point, Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 我在威斯康星州的史蒂文斯波伊特长大。

sentences.en: I'd call it affirmative action for flyover states.
sentences.zh: 我称之为对飞地州（Flyover states）的平权行动。

sentences.en: Like Harvard University takes 13 kids from Wisconsin no matter what every year.
sentences.zh: 就像哈佛大学每年无论如何都会从威斯康星州招收13个孩子。

sentences.en: And I was lucky enough to, you know, be blessed to get accepted to Harvard, so I went to school there.
sentences.zh: 我很幸运，你知道的，有幸被哈佛录取，所以我去那里上学了。

sentences.en: I was a Republican growing up, and I think Harvard and majoring in government and, you know, reading political philosophy about why government should exist,
sentences.zh: 我成长过程中是个共和党人，我想哈佛的主修政府学，你知道的，阅读关于政府为什么应该存在的政治哲学，

sentences.en: that's what made me a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 正是这些让我成了一名民主党人。

sentences.en: So after college, Kirk goes to Silicon Valley and makes a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 所以在大学毕业后，柯克去了硅谷赚了许多钱。

sentences.en: Then he moves to New York and tries to make it as a singer, but winds up in politics.
sentences.zh: 然后他搬到纽约，试图以歌手身份闯出一片天，但最终却投身于政治。

sentences.en: Believe it or not, I was Anthony Weiner's, you know, policy director when he ran for mayor.
sentences.zh: 信不信由你，安东尼·韦纳竞选市长时，我曾是他的政策主任。

sentences.en: That campaign notoriously went down in flames.
sentences.zh: 那次竞选臭名昭著地彻底搞砸了。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, his addictions came back, and so that was a defunct campaign.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，他的瘾头发作了，所以那是一场夭折的竞选。

sentences.en: But right around that time, my wife was diagnosed with lung cancer.
sentences.zh: 但正是在那个时候，我妻子被诊断出患有肺癌。

sentences.en: So I told her we should come to Manaqua because it's gorgeous in the summertime.
sentences.zh: 所以我告诉她我们应该来曼夸卡，因为这里夏天的景色美极了。

sentences.en: So we came here, and I bought this place because I just wanted to be more of a part of the community and not just work remotely.
sentences.zh: 于是我们来到了这里，我买下这个地方是因为我只想更多地融入社区，而不仅仅是远程工作。

sentences.en: So I've owned it now six years.
sentences.zh: 所以这个地方我现在已经拥有六年了。

sentences.en: My wife passed about two years ago.
sentences.zh: 我妻子在大约两年前去世了。

sentences.en: I was completely content to sing on this stage and, you know, do fun things with food and with wine and with beer.
sentences.zh: 我原本完全满足于在这个舞台上唱歌，你知道的，和食物、葡萄酒以及啤酒一起做一些有趣的事情。

sentences.en: And then, in April, as Kirk was watching the Republicans who control Wisconsin's state legislature respond to the pandemic, he says he became furious.
sentences.zh: 然后，在四月份，当柯克看到控制威斯康星州州议会的共和党人对大流行做出反应时，他说自己愤怒了。

sentences.en: He thought the party was putting people at risk.
sentences.zh: 他认为该党派将人们置于危险之中。

sentences.en: And that's when he decided to get into the race.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那时，他决定加入这场竞选。

sentences.en: So I think I know the answer to this, but I just want to ask it to make sure.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我大概知道这个问题的答案，但我只是想问一下以确认。,

sentences.en: So while some business owners were feeling that the government was overstepping, that the rules were too strict, that their businesses were on life support,
sentences.zh: 因此，当一些企业主觉得政府管得太宽、规则太严格、他们的企业命悬一线时，

sentences.en: you were frustrated not because the regulation was too strong and the mandates were too strict, but that you weren't seeing the rules enforced strictly enough.
sentences.zh: 你感到沮丧，不是因为规章制度太强、强制令太严格，而是因为你觉得规则执行得还不够严格。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 对，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: So you're very much running against the Republicans.
sentences.zh: 所以你很大程度上是在与共和党人唱反调。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, there's very little chance that I'd win this election.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我赢得这次选举的可能性微乎其微。

sentences.en: So to me, it gave me a platform to remind everybody constantly that we're hurting from COVID.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，这给我提供了一个平台，让我可以不断提醒大家，我们正饱受新冠疫情之苦。

sentences.en: There's no plan for COVID.
sentences.zh: 根本没有应对新冠的计划。

sentences.en: And the Republicans did this to us.
sentences.zh: 而共和党人就是这样对付我们的。

sentences.en: So Kirk is essentially running on the pandemic and he knows he stands little chance of beating Rob.
sentences.zh: 所以柯克基本上是围绕疫情在竞选，他也知道自己几乎没有胜算击败罗布。

sentences.en: I have been so safe and I've been so concerned about my employees and my patrons.
sentences.zh: 我一直都非常注意安全，也非常关心我的员工和顾客。

sentences.en: And I know that this guy is like the antithesis of that.
sentences.zh: 我知道这个人完全是那种做法的对立面。

sentences.en: How would you describe the electorate in this region?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这个地区的选民有什么特点？

sentences.en: And how do you make sense of their support for Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 你又怎么看待他们对唐纳德·特朗普的支持？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I can't explain that.
sentences.zh: 我解释不了。

sentences.en: I can't I can't tell you.
sentences.zh: 我没法……我没法告诉你。

sentences.en: I can't tell you why Trump is so popular up in this region.
sentences.zh: 我也说不清为什么特朗普在这个地区这么受欢迎。

sentences.en: I have to believe it's because they're consuming the wrong news.
sentences.zh: 我只能认为是因为他们接收了错误的新闻。

sentences.en: A lot of them, I feel,
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们当中有很多人

sentences.en: haven't been equipped with the tools of media literacy or critical thinking skills to be able to discern what what if they're being told something that doesn't quite gel or is not true.
sentences.zh: 都没有具备媒体素养或批判性思维的工具，无法分辨别人告诉他们的话是否契合事实或是否真实。

sentences.en: Do you expect long term implications to the to the business based on sort of having a giant Biden sign up there?
sentences.zh: 你觉得挂一个巨大的拜登标语会对生意产生长远的影响吗？

sentences.en: There will be locals that never come here again for sure.
sentences.zh: 肯定会有当地人再也不会来这里了。

sentences.en: There was one there was one real estate agent.
sentences.zh: 曾经有个……曾经有个房地产经纪人。

sentences.en: He was kind of the head of the office and he had had his Christmas party here a year ago.
sentences.zh: 他可以说是办公室的主管，一年前他在这里办过圣诞派对。

sentences.en: So and he private messaged me and he said, we're going to run you out of town and you better keep an eye open tonight.
sentences.zh: 然后他给我发了私信，说要把我们赶出小镇，让我今晚最好放机灵点。

sentences.en: And, you know, he was put on leave and they was forced to take like anger management courses because of that text.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，因为那条短信，他被停职了，还被迫去上诸如情绪管理的课程。

sentences.en: But but that's some of the types of virulent stuff that I've been getting.
sentences.zh: 但……但这就是我收到的一些充满恶意的言论。

sentences.en: How does that make you feel about your community?
sentences.zh: 这让你对你的社区有什么感觉？

sentences.en: Like, how does that make you feel about your future here in the community?
sentences.zh: 比如说，这让你对你在这里的未来有什么感觉？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I've questioned it before I was outspokenly liberal.
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，在我公开表明自己是自由派之前，我曾经质疑过。

sentences.en: I felt welcomed to this community, like the town board, you know, said you've added culture to our town and people thank me all the time.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己很受这个社区欢迎，比如镇议会曾说你为我们镇增添了文化气息，人们也总是向我道谢。

sentences.en: And they loved when I got up and sang French Edith Piaf songs.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢我起身演唱法国歌手伊迪丝·琵雅芙的歌曲。

sentences.en: You know, it's like they haven't gotten that before here.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们以前在这里没接触过这些。

sentences.en: So I felt really great about being here.
sentences.zh: 所以我对留在这里感觉非常好。

sentences.en: That's kind of a bigger fish in a smaller pond.
sentences.zh: 这有点像小池塘里的大鱼。

sentences.en: And I felt like people like were like thanked me for bringing more culture to this town.
sentences.zh: 我觉得人们就像是……感谢我给这个小镇带来了更多文化。

sentences.en: So right now, yeah, I mean, I feel like when I go to the grocery store,
sentences.zh: 所以现在，是的，我的意思是，我觉得当我走进杂货店时，

sentences.en: people look at me cross-eyed because they don't they they're so mad at me because of what I've what I've stood for in the last couple of months.
sentences.zh: 人们会斜眼看我，因为他们……因为我过去几个月所坚持的立场，他们对我很生气。

sentences.en: So it's weird, for sure.
sentences.zh: 所以这种感觉肯定很怪。

sentences.en: And that just makes me think of a couple of things you said.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了你刚才说的几件事。

sentences.en: And it has to do with, like, the feeling of belonging in this town.
sentences.zh: 这跟在这个小镇上的归属感有关。

sentences.en: I'm just curious, like you saying, you know, you're bigger fish in a smaller pond when you look at people around town and the way they vote.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，就像你说的，当你看看镇上的人以及他们的投票方式时，你觉得自己就像小池塘里的大鱼。

sentences.en: Like, maybe it has to do with the fact that they don't have the same critical thinking or media literacy skills.
sentences.zh: 这或许跟他们缺乏相同的批判性思维或媒体素养有关吧？

sentences.en: I think your opponent wants to characterize you as someone who doesn't belong here, who came from Harvard and does not have anything in common with the people who live here.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你的对手想把你塑造成一个不属于这里的人，一个从哈佛来的人，和这里的生活毫无共同点。

sentences.en: And I'm curious what you make of that argument.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道你对这种论调有什么看法。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, he wants to paint me that way.
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，他想把我描绘成那样。

sentences.en: And I always say, what's wrong with a little more intelligence in a small town?
sentences.zh: 我总是说，小镇多一点智慧有什么不好？

sentences.en: You know, what's wrong with kind of planning ahead, you know, or what's wrong with, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，未雨绸缪有什么不好，或者说，你知道的，

sentences.en: using critical thinking skills to figure out how to make the economy better in this area?
sentences.zh: 利用批判性思维来想办法改善这个地区的经济有什么不好？

sentences.en: I think I'm an asset to the community because I can bring ideas from Restaurant Week in New York City.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我是社区的宝贵资产，因为我可以带入纽约市餐厅周的理念。

sentences.en: I can bring ideas of, like, big data that Bloomberg used to, like, fix potholes.
sentences.zh: 我可以带入彭博社用来修补路坑那种大数据理念。

sentences.en: You know, it's like, all that government shit that is light years ahead of what we're doing here, I've experienced.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，所有那些比我们这里的做法领先光年之遥的政府行头，我都体验过。

sentences.en: Yeah, what's wrong with being elitist?
sentences.zh: 对，当精英有什么不好？

sentences.en: Why are we so anti-intellectual right now?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们现在这么反智？

sentences.en: Why is having a beer with somebody more of an attribute to vote for them than potentially thinking they're a cocky asshole but believing that they can make your life better?
sentences.zh: 为什么和某人喝杯啤酒，会比“觉得对方是个傲慢的混蛋，但相信对方能让你的生活变得更好”更能成为投票给他的理由？

sentences.en: You know, what's wrong with that?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这有什么不对？

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 免费解锁？

sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费体验《时报》一个月，而且不需要绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: Walking through the snow on a very cold day in Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 在威斯康星州一个非常寒冷的日子里走在雪地中。

sentences.en: So on our second day in Manaqua.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在马纳夸的第二天。

sentences.en: Kind of the main drag is the next three blocks or so in front of us.
sentences.zh: 前面的三个街区左右基本上就是主商业街了。

sentences.en: Luke, Andy, and I took a walk into town.
sentences.zh: 卢克、安迪和我步行进了镇子。

sentences.en: We walked through the snow, up to a bunch of local businesses along the city's main drag.
sentences.zh: 我们踏着雪，走到城市主商业街边的一排本地商铺前。

sentences.en: Looks like a jewelry consignment shop says masks are required.
sentences.zh: 看起来像是一家寄售珠宝店，上面写着必须佩戴口罩。

sentences.en: And we just popped in.
sentences.zh: 我们就顺便走了进去。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hi there.
sentences.zh: 你好啊。

sentences.en: To ask people who were working there, many of whom were business owners themselves, what side of this issue that Kirk and Rob were battling out.
sentences.zh: 去问问在那里工作的人——他们许多人自己也是企业主——柯克和罗布正在激烈争夺的这个议题，他们站在哪一边。

sentences.en: We've spoken to some small business owners, some of whom are really frustrated with the mandates coming down from Madison.
sentences.zh: 我们和一些小企业主聊过，其中有些人对来自麦迪逊的防疫强制令感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: And some of them saying that they feel as if they wish their community were taking it more seriously.
sentences.zh: 还有一些人说，他们希望自己的社区能更严肃地对待这件事。

sentences.en: They came down on.
sentences.zh: 他们落在了……

sentences.en: Where do you guys fall on that?
sentences.zh: 你们对此怎么看？

sentences.en: We wish that the community and the rest of the state would take it more seriously.
sentences.zh: 我们希望社区和全州其他地方能更严肃地对待它。

sentences.en: And just like Rob and Kirk.
sentences.zh: 就像罗布和柯克一样。

sentences.en: I really feel as we wear the masks that we somehow are not doing our bodies much good.
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得，我们戴着口罩，不知怎么的，对我们的身体并没有什么好处。

sentences.en: The community was split.
sentences.zh: 社区意见分歧。

sentences.en: It's very important to control this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 控制这场疫情非常重要。

sentences.en: The mandates seem fairly simple.
sentences.zh: 强制令看起来挺简单的。

sentences.en: Yes, the mandates are simple.
sentences.zh: 是的，强制令很简单。

sentences.en: Just wearing a mask is going to save thousands of lives.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是戴口罩就能拯救成千上万人的生命。

sentences.en: I'm not against the masks, but people are taking it to the extreme, though.
sentences.zh: 我不是反对口罩，但人们确实有点走极端了。

sentences.en: You're taking it a little bit too far.
sentences.zh: 你们有点太过分了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And do you see that hurting your business?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这会损害你的生意吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 会。

sentences.en: It is getting to be a bit much to still have masks on.
sentences.zh: 一直戴着口罩确实有点过头了。

sentences.en: It's just getting to be a lot.
sentences.zh: 这实在是有点受够了。

sentences.en: I want it to be over, but I want to do the right thing.
sentences.zh: 我希望这一切结束，但我又想做正确的事。

sentences.en: You want the mask mandates and the COVID and all the restrictions to be done.
sentences.zh: 你希望口罩强制令、新冠疫情以及所有的限制措施都结束。

sentences.en: Yes, but I think they're important.
sentences.zh: 是的，但我认为它们很重要。

sentences.en: Like, we can't keep spreading it to each other.
sentences.zh: 就像我们不能继续互相传染一样。

sentences.en: It's made a dent in the business.
sentences.zh: 这确实对生意造成了打击。

sentences.en: There's no question about that.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: But I care about people, and I hope they care about me.
sentences.zh: 但我关心别人，我也希望别人关心我。

sentences.en: And that's why I think masks are really, really important.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我认为口罩真的非常非常重要。

sentences.en: I try not to talk about it with a lot of people because everybody has their own feelings.
sentences.zh: 我尽量不和很多人谈论这个，因为每个人都有自己的感受。

sentences.en: It's not something always to bring up.
sentences.zh: 这并不是总能拿出来说的话题。

sentences.en: Eventually, Luke and I went off on our own to meet some people in town.
sentences.zh: 最终，我和卢克分头行动，去见见镇上的人。

sentences.en: This is the Shade Tree Bookstore.
sentences.zh: 这里是林荫书店。

sentences.en: While Andy walked into the local bookstore.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，安迪走进了当地的书店。

sentences.en: Hi there.
sentences.zh: 你好啊。

sentences.en: I'm going around talking to local folks about the election coming up.
sentences.zh: 我到处跟当地人聊聊即将到来的选举。

sentences.en: And that's where I met the owner, Tracy.
sentences.zh: 正是在那里我遇到了店主特雷西。

sentences.en: I think the whole mask thing has really worn out its welcome.
sentences.zh: 我觉得整件事情的口罩问题已经彻底让人厌烦了。

sentences.en: Who was working the register without a mask, and who turned out to be the most forceful proponent that we had yet met against the restrictions and guidelines coming from Madison?
sentences.zh: 她当时没戴口罩在收银台工作，结果证明她是我们遇到的态度最强硬的人，坚决反对来自麦迪逊的限制和指导方针。

sentences.en: I like to breathe fresh air.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢呼吸新鲜空气。

sentences.en: And I don't think wearing a dirty mask all day is really great for my health.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得整天戴着一个脏口罩对我的健康实在没有什么好处。

sentences.en: So I feel fine not wearing a mask.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉不戴口罩挺好的。

sentences.en: I support people if they want to wear it.
sentences.zh: 如果有人想戴，我支持他们。

sentences.en: I don't discourage them if they don't want to wear it.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不想戴，我也不去劝阻。

sentences.en: I just leave it up to the people to make their personal decisions because, well, until Biden gets elected, this is America.
sentences.zh: 我只是把决定权留给人们自己去做出个人决定，因为，好吧，在拜登当选之前，这里是美国。

sentences.en: And it should be the people's choice to choose whether they want to wear a mask or not.
sentences.zh: 人们应该有权选择自己是戴口罩还是不戴。

sentences.en: But I see people putting them on tiny children.
sentences.zh: 但我看到人们把口罩戴在小孩子脸上。

sentences.en: And I do not support that.
sentences.zh: 我不支持这样做。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 嗨，不好意思。

sentences.en: I'm in line here yakking.
sentences.zh: 我在排队这里唠嗑呢。

sentences.en: Well, you probably want to check out here.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你可能想在这里结账。

sentences.en: As we were sitting there talking, a customer who had a few books in her hand had walked up and was patiently waiting in line behind me.
sentences.zh: 正当我们坐在那儿聊天时，一个手里拿了几本书的顾客走了过来，耐心地在我身后排着队。

sentences.en: What do you think about what she's saying?
sentences.zh: 你觉得她刚才说的话怎么样？

sentences.en: Go, girl.
sentences.zh: 说得好，姑娘。

sentences.en: Go, girl.
sentences.zh: 说得好，姑娘。

sentences.en: I totally agree with her.
sentences.zh: 我完全同意她的看法。

sentences.en: What we're missing is common sense.
sentences.zh: 我们缺少的是常识。

sentences.en: Masks have their places, but they are not a cure-all.
sentences.zh: 口罩有它的用武之地，但它们并不是万灵药。

sentences.en: Well, you're wearing a mask.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你正戴着口罩呢。

sentences.en: Is there a reason?
sentences.zh: 有什么原因吗？

sentences.en: I don't want to offend other people.
sentences.zh: 我不想冒犯别人。

sentences.en: And I guess that's...
sentences.zh: 我想大概是……

sentences.en: I don't want to get in fights.
sentences.zh: 我不想惹上争执。

sentences.en: I don't want, you know, people might get mad or something.
sentences.zh: 我不想，你知道的，人们可能会生气什么的。
